en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a tree‑lined street leading to a grand stone railway station building. People, horse‑carts and early vehicles stand in front of the entrance. On the right is a separate smaller building and iron fencing, and in the background are additional historic multi‑storey buildings. The title text in Gothic‑style red lettering at the top reads "Chemnitz. Hauptbahnhof." indicating the main train station.
